title: Signal Over the South Bay: Cast of 100
note: All characters are original fiction. No real people are depicted.

factions.name: Aero Works Test Pilots
factions.blurb: The hangar crews and test pilots who build and fly tomorrow's ships off the El Segundo runway.

factions.name: Lantern Station Crew
factions.blurb: The crew of the broadcast station in the sky. They send the morning edition at 6:45, on the dot.

factions.name: Beach Patrol
factions.blurb: Lifeguards, surfers, skippers and swell-readers who keep the shoreline safe from Dockweiler to the Redondo breakwater.

factions.name: Main Street Regulars
factions.blurb: The diner, the barbershop, the radio shop and the library: the people who hear the morning edition first.

factions.name: Rec Park Paddle League
factions.blurb: Sunrise paddle players at Rec Park. The ladder starts at 6:45, right after the forecast.

factions.name: Refinery Night Shift
factions.blurb: The graveyard crew under the tank-farm lights. They hear the Lantern's signal before anyone else in town.

factions.name: The Morning Edition Desk
factions.blurb: The newsroom that writes the paper the Lantern sends: weather, tides, swell and news.

factions.name: Skywatch Observatory
factions.blurb: Astronomers and tinkerers on the Palos Verdes bluffs who watch the sky the Lantern lives in.

factions.name: Channel Static
factions.blurb: Rival broadcasters, schemers and pranksters who'd love to see the Lantern stay dark. Most of them can be talked down.

factions.name: Visitors from Orbit
factions.blurb: Travelers, oddities and neighbors from high above the bay, drawn in by the morning edition's signal.

characters.name: Capt. Della Marsh
characters.hook: The pilot who turned the Lantern's dish back toward home by hand.
characters.bio: Della flies the Gull for the El Segundo Aero Works and treats every test card like a promise. When the Lantern went dark at 4:12 A.M., she had the rocket-plane awake in ninety seconds. She gives the order first and the joke second.
characters.signature_look: Early 30s woman, warm brown skin, short dark curly hair, confident grin; teal flight suit with one bold orange chest stripe; white helmet with red visor and small gold star tucked under her arm

characters.name: Rusty Vance
characters.hook: He built half the dish, and he's not letting anyone fix it without him.
characters.bio: Rusty keeps the Lantern's transmitters humming and knows every bolt on the big dish by name. He talks fast, counts degrees out loud, and has never once lost his bow tie in zero gravity. He'd rather solder than sleep.
characters.signature_look: Lanky young man, freckles, messy red hair, black horn-rimmed glasses, big grin; cream short-sleeved shirt, red bow tie, leather tool belt strap over shoulder

characters.name: Maj. Teodoro "Teo" Arriaga
characters.hook: Has bailed out over the bay four times and walked home every time.
characters.bio: Teo flew the Aero Works' first rocket sled and still takes the riskiest test cards himself. He taught Della to land on a dead stick and reminds her of it weekly. He keeps a tide table in his flight-suit pocket, out of habit.
characters.signature_look: Mexican-American man in his late 50s, weathered tan face, silver mustache, crow's feet, steady eyes; worn orange flight jacket with sheepskin collar, old leather flying cap
characters.catchphrase: Fly it like you'll have to explain it.

characters.name: Junie Okafor
characters.hook: Nineteen, fearless, and first in line to fly the Gull someday.
characters.bio: Junie rigs control cables on the night line and memorizes every flight manual she can borrow. She has already logged forty glider hours over Dockweiler. Della pretends not to notice her taking notes.
characters.signature_look: Nigerian-American young woman age 19, dark skin, braids tied up under an orange kerchief, bright eager smile; teal coveralls with sleeves rolled, grease smudge on cheek
characters.catchphrase: Let me check the cables one more time.

characters.name: Dr. Harriet Lindqvist
characters.hook: She drew the Gull's delta wing on a diner napkin in 1957.
characters.bio: Harriet runs the Aero Works drafting room with a slide rule and a stopwatch. She designs for the pilot who has to come home. Her rule: if it can't be fixed with a wrench, redraw it.
characters.signature_look: Swedish-American woman in her 60s, pale skin, white hair in a tight bun, pencil behind ear, half-moon glasses on a chain; cream lab coat over navy sweater, slide rule in breast pocket

characters.name: Sgt. Bo Kalani
characters.hook: Nothing rolls onto his runway without his thumbs-up.
characters.bio: Bo has waved in every ship the Aero Works ever built, in fog, wind and sunset glare. He hums ukulele tunes over the tower frequency when the pilots get tense. His orange ear muffs are a local landmark.
characters.signature_look: Big broad-shouldered Native Hawaiian man in his 40s, warm brown skin, cheerful round face, short black hair; orange ear protectors around neck, teal ground crew vest over white T-shirt

characters.name: Sam Abernathy
characters.hook: The first person in town to notice the Lantern had gone dark.
characters.bio: Sam watches the scopes on the graveyard shift and keeps a log in perfect block capitals. At 4:12 A.M. his oscilloscope went flat and he woke the whole Aero Works. He brings the donuts on launch days.
characters.signature_look: Black man in his 40s, medium-dark skin, neat short hair, trim mustache, calm serious expression; headset with boom mic, cream cardigan over white shirt and navy tie

characters.name: Mei-Lin Cho
characters.hook: She can hear a bad wing in the wind tunnel before the gauges show it.
characters.bio: Mei-Lin runs the Aero Works wind tunnel and tests every model before it gets near a runway. She shaved two seconds off the Gull's climb with a single fin tweak. She surfs El Porto at lunch to study real turbulence.
characters.signature_look: Chinese-American woman in her late 20s, straight black hair in a short bob, cat-eye glasses, focused expression; white lab coat with teal collar, small airfoil model in hand
characters.catchphrase: The air always tells the truth.

characters.name: Tuggy (TOWBOT-7)
characters.hook: A squat orange robot that pushes rocket-planes and wants to be loved.
characters.bio: Tuggy tows the Gull from the hangar to the runway every morning and beeps a little tune when it gets there. It has a strong sense of duty and a weak sense of direction. The crew pats its dome for luck.
characters.signature_look: Small squat round robot, bright orange painted metal body, single round lens eye glowing cream, little rivets, stubby antenna, cheerful friendly design, dome head

characters.name: Wren Halloway
characters.hook: Seventy years old, three thousand jumps, and she still packs every chute by hand.
characters.bio: Wren folded parachutes for the first jet pilots and never retired. Every pilot at the Aero Works has her name stitched inside a canopy. She tells the story of each jump in exact numbers.
characters.signature_look: White woman in her 70s, short silver hair, sun-weathered face, sharp blue eyes, wry smile; red jumpsuit with parachute harness straps, silk scarf

characters.name: Lt. Rex Dunmore
characters.hook: Della's fiercest competition and the first to cheer when she lands.
characters.bio: Rex flies the Kestrel, the Aero Works' other experimental ship, and wants the altitude record back. He's cocky in the ready room and generous on the radio. He'll race Della to the Lantern any day of the week.
characters.signature_look: White man in his early 30s, square jaw, slicked-back blond hair, cocky half-smile; cream flight suit with red shoulder stripes, aviator sunglasses pushed up on head
characters.catchphrase: Second place is a long way down, Marsh.

characters.name: Chief Odessa Pryce
characters.hook: She runs the station in the sky like a lighthouse keeper with a stopwatch.
characters.bio: Odessa has commanded the Lantern since it first lit up over the bay. She checks the 6:45 broadcast clock three times every morning. Her calm voice on the radio has talked down more than one nervous shuttle pilot.
characters.signature_look: Black woman in her 50s, dark brown skin, short natural grey-streaked hair, pearl earrings, composed authoritative smile; navy blazer with teal piping and a small orange beacon pin, headset

characters.name: Farouk "Mo" Haddad
characters.hook: The warm voice that says good morning to every beach-house radio.
characters.bio: Mo reads the morning edition live from the Lantern's studio deck: weather, tides, swell and news. He practices his vowels while floating upside down. Half the South Bay sets its watch by his sign-on.
characters.signature_look: Lebanese-American man in his 40s, olive skin, neat wavy black hair with grey temples, warm smile; cream shirt with sleeve garters, red tie, vintage ribbon microphone beside him

characters.name: Tess Kowalczyk
characters.hook: She's walked the outside of the Lantern more times than anyone alive.
characters.bio: Tess handles the outside jobs: tightening mast guys, clearing frost off the dish, chasing loose bolts. She wears magnetic boots everywhere, even at the Main Street diner. Rusty trusts her torque wrench more than his own.
characters.signature_look: Polish-American woman in her 30s, fair skin, short platinum blond crewcut, strong jaw, determined look; white spacesuit with teal panels, silver bubble helmet held under arm

characters.name: Dr. Anand Iyer
characters.hook: He keeps a whole radio station from drifting off its spot in the sky.
characters.bio: Anand runs the station-keeping thrusters and computes the Lantern's position every hour by hand and by machine. He plotted the meteor shower's path after the fact and hasn't forgiven himself. He's working on a warning system now.
characters.signature_look: Indian-American man in his 30s, brown skin, neat black hair, thin wire glasses, thoughtful expression; navy turtleneck with a teal Lantern patch, pencil behind ear

characters.name: Penny Ashworth
characters.hook: Her coffee floats, her pies don't, and nobody goes hungry on her deck.
characters.bio: Penny keeps the Lantern stocked with everything from vacuum tubes to cinnamon rolls. She invented a lidded mug for zero gravity that the Aero Works now builds by the dozen. She knows everyone's birthday.
characters.signature_look: Plump white woman in her 60s, rosy cheeks, curly grey hair pinned up, kind smile; orange apron over cream blouse, little paper cap

characters.name: Beacon (B-4C0N)
characters.hook: The robot that tends the orange beacon and hums along with the morning edition.
characters.bio: Beacon polishes the crown lamp, logs signal strength and patrols the ring corridors on soft rubber wheels. During the blackout it kept the beacon lamp warm with its own battery. It has a fondness for weather reports.
characters.signature_look: Friendly tall robot, cream and teal enamel body, round dome head with a glowing orange lamp on top, two round eye lenses, mesh speaker grille mouth, retro 1950s robot design

characters.name: Lucy Tanaka
characters.hook: Seventeen, a ham radio prodigy, and the youngest crew member in orbit.
characters.bio: Lucy won a scholarship to the Lantern after building a receiver that picked up the station from her Gardena garage. She handles the overnight relay logs. She's teaching Beacon to tell jokes.
characters.signature_look: Japanese-American teenage girl age 17, black hair in a high ponytail, bangs, bright curious eyes; big headphones around neck, teal crew jumpsuit with patches

characters.name: Hollis Grant
characters.hook: He flies the milk run up to the Lantern twice a week and never misses.
characters.bio: Hollis ferries mail, groceries and spare tubes from LAX to the station in an old cargo shuttle he calls Biscuit Tin. He's flown it so long he can dock by feel. He tells long stories and short jokes.
characters.signature_look: Black man in his 60s, deep brown skin, grey beard, kind eyes, toothpick in mouth; worn navy pilot jacket with orange patches, old peaked pilot cap

characters.name: Pip
characters.hook: A tabby with a tiny bubble helmet who has never once landed on her feet up there.
characters.bio: Pip stowed away in a mail sack and was promoted to official mouser on arrival. There are no mice, but she patrols anyway. She sleeps on the warm transmitter cabinet during the broadcast.
characters.signature_look: Orange tabby cat wearing a tiny clear bubble space helmet and a little teal collar with a star tag, curious wide eyes

characters.name: Lt. Marisol Reyes
characters.hook: Nobody goes past the buoys on her watch.
characters.bio: Marisol runs the Manhattan Beach towers and can read a rip current from a quarter mile. She listens to the Lantern's swell report before she unlocks a single tower. She's pulled two hundred swimmers out of the surf and remembers every name.
characters.signature_look: Mexican-American woman in her 40s, tan skin, long dark hair tied back, white zinc on nose, alert eyes; red lifeguard swimsuit with a cream jacket, silver whistle on a lanyard

characters.name: Kip Lomax
characters.hook: The first one in the water every morning, and the first to call the swell wrong.
characters.bio: Kip waxes his board to the morning edition and argues with the swell report like it can hear him. He works afternoons at the Hermosa board shop. He's never on time for anything except a set wave.
characters.signature_look: White young man in his mid 20s, sun-bleached shaggy blond hair, tanned, easygoing grin; open teal Hawaiian shirt with orange hibiscus pattern, puka shell necklace
characters.catchphrase: Two to three? Feels like four.

characters.name: Ruth Feld
characters.hook: Eighty years old, pier to pier, every single day since 1931.
characters.bio: Ruth swims from the Hermosa pier to the Manhattan pier at sunrise and back by breakfast. The lifeguards set their clocks by her flowered swim cap. She has opinions about the water temperature and shares them.
characters.signature_look: Jewish white woman in her 80s, wrinkled cheerful face, bright eyes, big smile; vintage white swim cap covered in rubber flowers, red one-piece swimsuit strap visible, towel over shoulder

characters.name: Theo Banks
characters.hook: Twelve years old, oversized goggles, and extremely serious about water safety.
characters.bio: Theo is the youngest junior guard in the South Bay and carries his rescue can everywhere. He wants to be Marisol when he grows up, or maybe an astronaut. Possibly both.
characters.signature_look: Black boy age 12, brown skin, short cropped hair, earnest proud expression; big round swim goggles pushed up on forehead, red junior lifeguard shirt

characters.name: Cap. Ernesto "Salt" Salazar
characters.hook: He's towed more boats into King Harbor than anyone can count.
characters.bio: Salt captains the Redondo harbor patrol boat and knows every rock off Palos Verdes. He keeps a radio tuned to the Lantern in the wheelhouse for the tide times. He feeds the sea lions when he thinks nobody is watching.
characters.signature_look: Filipino-American man in his 60s, weathered brown skin, grey stubble, squinting kind eyes; navy wool peacoat, white captain's cap with gold braid

characters.name: Nalani Brooks
characters.hook: She swims into the impact zone with a camera so the rest of us can see it.
characters.bio: Nalani shoots the Hermosa lineup from inside the wave with a homemade waterproof housing. Her photos run on the morning edition's swell page every Saturday. She once photographed the Gull streaking over a closeout set.
characters.signature_look: Mixed Native Hawaiian and Black woman in her late 20s, curly hair pulled up, freckles, bright smile; teal wetsuit top, boxy waterproof camera housing held up beside her face

characters.name: Biscuit
characters.hook: A golden retriever in a life vest who has never met a swimmer she didn't want to save.
characters.bio: Biscuit rides in the patrol jeep and fetches rescue buoys before anyone throws them. She has three official commendations and one for stealing a hot dog. Every kid on the beach knows her name.
characters.signature_look: Happy golden retriever dog wearing a small red life vest with a cream cross patch, tongue out, ears flopping

characters.name: Skimmer
characters.hook: A hovering robot buoy that zips out to swimmers faster than any guard can paddle.
characters.bio: Skimmer was built at the Aero Works from a surplus jet nozzle and a lot of optimism. It hovers over the surf on a cushion of air and drops a float to anyone in trouble. It flashes orange when it's proud of itself.
characters.signature_look: Round hovering robot shaped like a rescue buoy, bright orange and cream striped body, single glowing teal eye, small jet nozzles, cheerful design

characters.name: Gus Petrakis
characters.hook: He's been at the end of the pier since before there was a pier.
characters.bio: Gus sells bait, coffee and unsolicited fishing advice at the end of the Hermosa pier. He claims he saw the Lantern blink out before the Aero Works did. He might be right.
characters.signature_look: Greek-American man in his 60s, olive skin, bushy white eyebrows, big grey mustache, laugh lines; navy fisherman's sweater, faded captain's hat

characters.name: Dr. Rae Chen-Whitfield
characters.hook: She measures the swell so the morning edition can report it.
characters.bio: Rae runs the tide-and-swell gauges off the Redondo breakwater and phones the numbers to the newsroom at 5 A.M. sharp. She designed a buoy that radios wave height straight to the Lantern. She surfs to calibrate.
characters.signature_look: Chinese and white woman in her 30s, shoulder-length dark brown hair, sun freckles, focused smile; cream rain slicker over a teal sweater, clipboard

characters.name: Lorraine "Lolo" DeMarco
characters.hook: Coffee's on at 5, the morning edition's on at 6:45, and nobody leaves hungry.
characters.bio: Lolo has run the Starliner Diner for twenty years and keeps the big radio behind the counter tuned to the Lantern. On the morning it went dark, she poured coffee for the whole Aero Works for free. She knows everybody's order and most of their secrets.
characters.signature_look: Italian-American woman in her 50s, tall teased auburn beehive hair, red lipstick, pencil tucked behind ear, knowing smile; teal waitress dress with cream collar and name pin

characters.name: Elias Wexler
characters.hook: The best flattop in the South Bay, with the news read aloud.
characters.bio: Elias has cut hair on Main Street since the first jet landed at LAX. He reads the morning edition aloud to customers who already heard it on the radio. He hands out lollipops and advice in equal measure.
characters.signature_look: Jewish man in his 70s, white skin, bald on top with white fringe, bushy eyebrows, warm smile; white barber's tunic, comb in breast pocket, thin red bow tie

characters.name: Benny Navarro
characters.hook: He delivers the printed edition to every porch before the radio finishes reading it.
characters.bio: Benny bolted a surplus jet nozzle to his bike and is now the fastest paperboy in California. He throws papers with perfect aim and terrible handwriting on his route card. He'd like to fly the Gull, but he'll settle for the Kestrel.
characters.signature_look: Mexican-American boy age 11, brown skin, gap-toothed grin, messy black hair; tweed newsboy cap, red jacket, canvas newspaper bag strap over shoulder, goggles around neck

characters.name: Clementine Ayodele
characters.hook: She can find any book, any map, and any fact before you finish asking.
characters.bio: Clementine runs the El Segundo library and keeps a shelf of every morning edition ever printed. She found the old meteor-shower charts that helped the Skywatch crew. She shushes with great kindness.
characters.signature_look: Black woman in her 40s, dark skin, hair in an elegant updo, cat-eye glasses with pearl chain, poised smile; mustard cardigan over a cream blouse, brooch

characters.name: Officer Frank Mulcahy
characters.hook: He helps more people across the street than he's ever written tickets.
characters.bio: Frank walks the Main Street beat on foot and on a little blue scooter. His idea of a big case is a lost dog. He's the first to show up when anyone needs a hand.
characters.signature_look: Irish-American man in his 50s, ruddy pale skin, red cheeks, grey sideburns, friendly face; navy police uniform with peaked cap and badge

characters.name: Rosa Iturbe
characters.hook: If your radio can't hear the Lantern, she'll fix it by lunch.
characters.bio: Rosa runs Iturbe Electric, the radio and TV repair shop next to the diner. During the blackout, she tested every set in town to prove the problem was in the sky. She and Rusty trade spare tubes and arguments.
characters.signature_look: Mexican-American woman in her 30s, brown skin, dark hair in a red bandana, determined smile; teal work shirt with sleeves rolled, magnifying loupe on headband

characters.name: Mayor Dorothy "Dot" Pemberton
characters.hook: She's cut every ribbon in town and kept the scissors.
characters.bio: Dot has been mayor for three terms and knows every street by its potholes. She went on the radio after the blackout to tell everyone the paper would be on time. It was.
characters.signature_look: White woman in her 60s, white curled hair, pearls, warm confident smile; cream suit jacket with a big orange flower corsage, small pillbox hat

characters.name: Sully
characters.hook: Four arms, eight eggs, zero burnt toast.
characters.bio: Sully cooks breakfast at the Starliner with four chrome arms and an internal clock synced to the Lantern. When the signal dropped, it served breakfast eight minutes early out of confusion. Nobody complained.
characters.signature_look: Chrome and cream retro robot cook with a tall white chef's hat, four arms holding spatulas, round friendly face with two round eyes, glowing orange mouth grille

characters.name: Mrs. Kim Soon-ja
characters.hook: Every kid on Main Street gets an orange on the way to school.
characters.bio: Mrs. Kim runs the corner market and keeps a ledger of who owes what that she never collects on. She listens to the morning edition while stacking oranges in perfect pyramids. She trusts the Lantern's weather more than her knee.
characters.signature_look: Korean woman in her 60s, short permed grey-black hair, kind crinkled eyes, slight smile; red cardigan over a white blouse, holding an orange

characters.name: Ziggy Moreau
characters.hook: He knows every song that's ever played on the Lantern's evening hour.
characters.bio: Ziggy works the counter at Platter Planet and DJs the high school dances. He keeps a notebook of every song the Lantern plays and calls in requests from the phone booth outside. He's sure he'll be on the air someday.
characters.signature_look: Black and French young man age 19, brown skin, tall pompadour, pencil mustache, easy grin; cream varsity-style jacket with orange sleeves, vinyl record in hand

characters.name: Coach Walt Ferreira
characters.hook: He runs the sunrise ladder at Rec Park with a clipboard and a cowbell.
characters.bio: Walt founded the Rec Park paddle league and has posted every result on the bulletin board since. He starts the ladder the second the morning edition signs off. He takes rule disputes very seriously and pickles very lightly.
characters.signature_look: Portuguese-American man in his 70s, tan skin, white crewcut, bushy white eyebrows, cheerful face; teal sun visor, cream polo shirt, whistle on lanyard

characters.name: Opal Haverford
characters.hook: One half of the Haverford twins, the best dink in the South Bay.
characters.bio: Opal and her twin Pearl haven't lost a doubles match since the Gull's first flight. Opal plays the left side and talks the whole time. She bakes lemon bars for anyone who takes a game off them.
characters.signature_look: White woman in her 60s, silver bob with a teal headband, twinkling eyes, playful grin; cream tennis sweater with teal trim, pearl stud earrings

characters.name: Pearl Haverford
characters.hook: The quiet Haverford twin, and the one who hits the winners.
characters.bio: Pearl plays the right side and says perhaps four words a match. She keeps the twins' trophies polished and their record in a little red book. She'd like you to know Opal foot-faults.
characters.signature_look: White woman in her 60s, silver bob with an orange headband, cool sly half-smile, dry expression; cream tennis sweater with orange trim, small gold locket

characters.name: Desmond "Dez" Okoye
characters.hook: The hardest smash at Rec Park, and he's working on his patience.
characters.bio: Dez works the morning shift at LAX and plays paddle before and after. He's climbed the ladder to the top three and wants a shot at the Haverfords. He counts down his serves like a launch.
characters.signature_look: Nigerian-American young man in his mid 20s, dark skin, short fade haircut, focused grin; red sweatband on forehead, teal athletic shirt, wooden paddle on shoulder

characters.name: Lupe Garza
characters.hook: Mother of four, keeper of the ladder, and nobody argues with her pencil.
characters.bio: Lupe keeps the league's books, schedules and snack rotation in one battered binder. She plays a mean lob between school drop-offs. She's the reason the league has never once started late.
characters.signature_look: Mexican-American woman in her 40s, brown skin, dark wavy hair in a ponytail, big warm laugh; mustard gingham blouse, pencil behind ear, binder against chest

characters.name: Ravi Menon
characters.hook: A retired Aero Works engineer who builds paddles out of aircraft honeycomb.
characters.bio: Ravi spent thirty years designing wing panels and now makes the lightest paddles in the league in his garage. Half the players use one. He insists on measuring everyone's swing first.
characters.signature_look: Indian-American man in his late 60s, brown skin, neat white beard, thick black-rimmed glasses, gentle smile; tweed cap, cream cardigan, holding a honeycomb paddle

characters.name: Sprocket
characters.hook: A practice robot that serves balls, keeps score, and cheers too loudly.
characters.bio: Sprocket was built from a surplus radar dish base and a gumball machine. It feeds practice balls at 6 A.M. and announces scores in a booming voice. It has a crush on the court-side scoreboard.
characters.signature_look: Cheerful short retro robot shaped like a gumball machine, clear dome full of yellow balls on top, caption-gold and teal enamel body, two round eyes, small speaker mouth

characters.name: Kenji Arai
characters.hook: Eighty years old and undefeated on court 3 before 7 A.M.
characters.bio: Kenji was gardening at Rec Park before it was a park and has played on court 3 every morning since it opened. He never runs and never loses. After the game, he waters the roses.
characters.signature_look: Japanese-American man in his 80s, deeply lined face, short white hair, calm serene smile; white bucket hat, teal windbreaker

characters.name: Bev Tolliver
characters.hook: Her megaphone can be heard from the refinery.
characters.bio: Bev calls every match at Rec Park from a lawn chair with a megaphone and a thermos. She does play-by-play like it's the Rose Bowl. She's applied to read sports on the Lantern four times.
characters.signature_look: Black woman in her 50s, brown skin, short curly hair, big expressive laugh; red cat-eye sunglasses, orange scarf, holding a cream megaphone

characters.name: Scout
characters.hook: A clever crow who steals stray balls and returns them for peanuts.
characters.bio: Scout has learned the league schedule better than most of the players. She steals any ball that rolls past the fence and trades it back for a peanut. Walt has made her an honorary ball girl.
characters.signature_look: Glossy black crow with a clever look, holding a yellow pickleball in its beak, tiny teal band on its leg

characters.name: Big Lou Santangelo
characters.hook: He's run the graveyard shift for twenty-five years without a single bad night.
characters.bio: Lou knows every valve in the tank farm and walks the whole fence line before midnight. He keeps a radio in his lunch pail for the Lantern's overnight music. When it went quiet, he was the second call the Aero Works got.
characters.signature_look: Italian-American man in his 50s, olive skin, big build, thick black mustache, stubble, kind tired eyes; white hard hat, navy work jacket with orange reflective stripes
characters.catchphrase: Safe and steady, boys and girls.

characters.name: Valentina Cruz
characters.hook: Her welds hold at three hundred pounds of pressure and her nerve holds better.
characters.bio: Valentina fixes pipes on the night shift and welds sculptures out of scrap on weekends. One of them stands outside the Aero Works. She'd love to weld something in orbit.
characters.signature_look: Salvadoran-American woman in her 30s, brown skin, black hair tied back, smudged cheek, confident smirk; welding mask flipped up on her head, navy coveralls, leather gloves

characters.name: Dr. Obi Nwankwo
characters.hook: He runs the overnight lab and makes better coffee with chemistry than anyone with a pot.
characters.bio: Obi tests samples through the night and writes poetry on the back of lab forms. He helped Rusty design a heat shield coating for the dish. He's gentle, precise, and always humming.
characters.signature_look: Nigerian-born man in his 40s, dark skin, short greying hair, round wire glasses, gentle smile; white lab coat over navy coveralls, test tube in breast pocket

characters.name: Earl Whitcomb
characters.hook: He's watched the Lantern's beacon from the gatehouse every night for thirty years.
characters.bio: Earl keeps the refinery gate with a flashlight, a thermos and a transistor radio. He noticed the beacon go dark and called the Aero Works himself, only to find the line busy. He is still telling people about it.
characters.signature_look: White man in his 70s, thin, wrinkled face, white stubble, bushy eyebrows, droopy kind eyes; navy watchman's cap and jacket with badge, flashlight

characters.name: Flare
characters.hook: A tall spindly robot that climbs flare stacks so people don't have to.
characters.bio: Flare checks the tops of the tanks and stacks with a searchlight eye and long telescoping legs. It's shy around people and chatty with gulls. It reports its findings in tidy little beeps.
characters.signature_look: Tall slender retro robot with a long neck and a single round searchlight eye glowing orange, navy and cream panels, small antenna, gentle shy look

characters.name: Sunny Phan
characters.hook: She wears aviator sunglasses at midnight and can thread a pipe through a keyhole.
characters.bio: Sunny runs the big crane on the night shift and hums along to the Lantern while she works. She has the steadiest hands on the coast. She lifted the spare dish segment onto the Gull's cargo sled in four minutes flat.
characters.signature_look: Vietnamese-American woman in her 20s, light brown skin, shoulder-length black hair, aviator sunglasses, cool confident smile; navy work jacket, orange hard hat

characters.name: Ida Mae Robinson
characters.hook: Her 3 A.M. biscuits are the reason half the night shift shows up.
characters.bio: Ida Mae drives the canteen truck from tank farm to gatehouse every night. She feeds the refinery crew, the Aero Works night line and anyone who looks hungry. She keeps the radio up loud.
characters.signature_look: Black woman in her 60s, deep brown skin, grey hair under a red headscarf, big warm smile; cream apron over a teal dress

characters.name: Jasper Kincaid
characters.hook: The loudest voice at the refinery, and he's never once raised it in anger.
characters.bio: Jasper runs safety drills and checks every hard hat before a shift starts. He's strict about rules and soft about people. He knows the evacuation route for every building in El Segundo by heart.
characters.signature_look: White man in his 40s, buzzcut, square jaw, strong eyebrows, serious but kind expression; bright orange safety vest over navy shirt, clipboard

characters.name: Marguerite "Gigi" Lafleur
characters.hook: She climbs the tallest tank every night just to say hello to the Lantern.
characters.bio: Gigi reads tank levels at the top of the ladders and waves at the beacon every night. She swears it waves back. She sings the overnight songs in French.
characters.signature_look: Cajun woman in her 30s, light olive skin, short dark curls, freckles, cheerful smile; navy coveralls, teal neckerchief, flashlight clipped to strap

characters.name: Ratchet
characters.hook: An opossum who lives under the canteen truck and eats everyone's crusts.
characters.bio: Ratchet showed up during a night shift and refused to leave. The crew made him a tiny hard hat. He plays dead whenever the safety drill siren goes off, which counts as compliance.
characters.signature_look: Cute grey-and-white opossum wearing a tiny orange hard hat, pink nose, beady friendly eyes

characters.name: Augustina "Gussie" Vale
characters.hook: She decides what the whole South Bay hears at 6:45, and she has never missed a deadline.
characters.bio: Gussie runs the newsroom with a red pencil and a stopwatch. She wired the morning edition to the Lantern at 6:38 every day for twenty years. During the blackout, she had the paper ready to go the second the signal returned.
characters.signature_look: White woman in her 60s, sharp silver bob, red reading glasses on her head, stern but warm look; green eyeshade visor, cream blouse with rolled sleeves, red pencil in hand

characters.name: Freddie Osei
characters.hook: Twenty-two, first job, press card in his hat, and already on the biggest story in town.
characters.bio: Freddie was on the night desk when the Lantern went dark and wrote the whole story before sunrise. Gussie cut it in half and ran it on the front page. He carries three pencils in case two break.
characters.signature_look: Ghanaian-American young man age 22, dark skin, short neat hair, wide eager eyes; brown fedora with a PRESS card tucked in the band, cream shirt, red tie, notebook

characters.name: Dr. June Albright
characters.hook: She has called the marine layer correctly for 1,400 mornings straight.
characters.bio: June writes the weather for the morning edition from a rooftop station full of barometers and wind cups. She's never been fooled by June gloom. She gets a little smug about it.
characters.signature_look: Black woman in her 40s, medium brown skin, short pressed hair, pearl earrings, confident smile; teal suit jacket with a barometer-shaped brooch, pointer in hand

characters.name: Tito Albañez
characters.hook: He writes the swell report every morning, then paddles out to check it.
characters.bio: Tito turns Rae's buoy numbers into two sentences every surfer reads. He's been wrong exactly twice and wrote a correction both times. He keeps a longboard behind the newsroom door.
characters.signature_look: Puerto Rican man in his 30s, tan skin, curly black hair, short beard, relaxed grin; open-collar cream shirt with an orange wave pattern, pencil behind ear

characters.name: Hazel Grimsby
characters.hook: She sets the printed edition in hot metal faster than most people type.
characters.bio: Hazel has run the newsroom's Linotype since before radio could reach the sky. She sets the paper for porch delivery while the Lantern reads it aloud. She catches every typo and keeps a jar of them.
characters.signature_look: White woman in her 70s, thin, white hair in a neat bun, sharp eyes behind round spectacles, small proud smile; ink-stained red apron over a cream blouse, sleeve protectors

characters.name: Lou Kaminski
characters.hook: His flash bulb has caught every launch from the Aero Works since 1955.
characters.bio: Lou shoots for the morning edition with a big press camera and a pocket full of bulbs. He got the picture of the Gull's contrail over the beach at dawn. He likes faces more than rockets.
characters.signature_look: Polish-American man in his 50s, pale skin, heavy jowls, five o'clock shadow, broad grin; rumpled navy suit, loosened tie, holding a large vintage press camera with flash

characters.name: Teletype Tilly
characters.hook: A clacking robot that reads every wire report in the world and hums the important parts.
characters.bio: Tilly prints the overnight wire stories on long rolls of paper and sorts them into piles for Gussie. She's built from an old teletype and a lot of Rusty's spare parts. She chimes when news is good.
characters.signature_look: Boxy retro robot built from a teletype machine, cream and red enamel, paper tape spilling from its mouth slot, two round lamp eyes, small typewriter keys on its chest

characters.name: Archie Sun
characters.hook: He holds the newsroom together from midnight to dawn with sleeve garters and patience.
characters.bio: Archie edits the overnight copy and answers every phone call that comes in after dark. He took the Aero Works call at 4:14 A.M. and started a fresh pot of coffee. He's never once raised his voice.
characters.signature_look: Chinese-American man in his 50s, short greying hair, calm tired eyes, gentle smile; white shirt with red sleeve garters, loosened navy tie, telephone receiver on shoulder

characters.name: Paz Romero
characters.hook: She covers the Rec Park paddle ladder like it's the World Series.
characters.bio: Paz writes the sports column, which means mostly paddle, surf contests and high school track. She gave the Haverford twins their nickname, the Dink Sisters. She's training for the next pier-to-pier swim.
characters.signature_look: Mexican-American woman in her 30s, brown skin, short wavy black hair, wide grin; red sun visor, cream sweater, notebook and stopwatch

characters.name: Inkwell
characters.hook: A pigeon who carries late corrections from the newsroom to the print shop.
characters.bio: Inkwell was hatched on the newsroom roof and trained by Hazel. She has never dropped a correction, though she once delivered a sandwich by mistake. She wears a tiny red message tube on her leg.
characters.signature_look: Grey and iridescent pigeon with an alert look, tiny red message capsule on its leg, small cream press tag on a ribbon

characters.name: Dr. Celestine Marchetti
characters.hook: She runs the biggest telescope on the bluffs and still lets the kids look first.
characters.bio: Celestine has run the Skywatch Observatory for fifteen years and maps the paths of everything that crosses the Lantern's orbit. After the blackout, she built a meteor alert line straight to the station. Her open nights are the most popular thing on the peninsula.
characters.signature_look: Italian-American woman in her 50s, olive skin, dark hair with a white streak in a loose chignon, intelligent eyes, warm smile; navy turtleneck, cream lab coat, star-chart scarf

characters.name: Prof. Ignatius Thorne
characters.hook: He predicted the meteor shower that hit the Lantern, and nobody read the paper.
characters.bio: Ignatius has been tracking meteor streams for sixty years and filed his warning in a journal nobody opened. He is too polite to say he told them so, and says it anyway. He's now Anand's favorite pen pal.
characters.signature_look: White man in his 80s, gaunt, wild white hair, long white eyebrows, sharp twinkling eyes; tweed jacket with elbow patches, bow tie, magnifying glass

characters.name: Dr. Yuki Hamasaki
characters.hook: She listens to the stars, and lately they've been listening back.
characters.bio: Yuki runs the observatory's radio dish and catalogues every strange signal from the sky. She was the first to hear the Choir. She keeps a notebook of sounds no one else can hear.
characters.signature_look: Japanese-American woman in her 30s, straight black hair with blunt bangs, thoughtful expression; large headphones, teal sweater, notebook

characters.name: Dr. Ezra Goldfarb
characters.hook: His eyebrows have grown back eleven times.
characters.bio: Ezra designs rocket fuel in a shed behind the observatory and is the reason the Gull climbs as fast as it does. His experiments are famous on the peninsula for their noise. He is very careful, mostly.
characters.signature_look: Jewish man in his 50s, pale skin, wild frizzy grey hair, singed eyebrows, delighted expression; goggles pushed up on forehead, cream lab coat with scorch marks

characters.name: Amara Diallo
characters.hook: She found the Lantern's missing dish bolt with a telescope, 22,000 miles up.
characters.bio: Amara works the overnight telescope shift and has discovered two comets and one runaway bolt. She wants to be the first astronomer on the Lantern. She's writing a thesis on micrometeor showers.
characters.signature_look: Senegalese-American woman in her mid 20s, dark skin, short natural hair, bright smile; orange knit beanie, navy peacoat, star chart rolled under arm

characters.name: Dr. Ingrid Solberg
characters.hook: She's building the Lantern a little sister that will watch the clouds.
characters.bio: Ingrid designs weather satellites that will one day send cloud pictures to the morning edition. She's patient, methodical and impossible to rush. She drinks her coffee black and cold.
characters.signature_look: Norwegian-American woman in her 40s, fair skin, straight blond hair in a low ponytail, calm blue eyes; cream turtleneck, small teal satellite pin

characters.name: ORRERY
characters.hook: A room-sized computer with a face made of spinning tape reels.
characters.bio: ORRERY calculates orbits for the observatory and, lately, for the Lantern. It speaks in a slow, polite voice and dims its lights when it's thinking. It's very proud of its brass planetary model.
characters.signature_look: Large retro computer robot head made of two spinning tape reels as eyes, rows of blinking lights, cream and teal panels, small brass planets orbiting above its head

characters.name: Dr. Rafael Quiñones
characters.hook: He feels every tremor on the peninsula and tells the newsroom before breakfast.
characters.bio: Rafael watches the seismographs in the observatory basement and walks the cliffs every morning. He reports quakes, landslides and tide pools to the morning edition. He has a rock collection in every pocket.
characters.signature_look: Colombian-American man in his 40s, tan skin, curly dark hair, full beard, friendly eyes; khaki field vest over a teal shirt, rock hammer on belt
characters.catchphrase: The ground has something to say.

characters.name: Prof. Winnie Achterberg
characters.hook: She grinds every telescope mirror on the bluffs by hand.
characters.bio: Winnie has ground mirrors for fifty years and taught half the South Bay how to build a telescope. Her workshop smells of pitch and polish. She gives every new telescope a name.
characters.signature_look: Dutch-American woman in her 70s, fair skin, short white hair, round glasses, rosy cheeks, cheerful smile; orange smock with polishing powder, round telescope mirror in her hands

characters.name: Kepler
characters.hook: A barn owl who lives in the dome and hoots when a meteor crosses the sky.
characters.bio: Kepler roosts in the dome rafters and has better night vision than any telescope. The staff swear he hoots at meteors before the instruments see them. He's never wrong.
characters.signature_look: Barn owl with a heart-shaped white face, big dark eyes, wise look, tiny teal band on his leg

characters.name: Sterling Marlowe
characters.hook: A slick broadcaster who wants the South Bay to hear his jingles at 6:45 instead.
characters.bio: Sterling runs Channel Static from a converted barge in international waters and sells airtime by the second. He'd love for the Lantern to stay dark long enough for listeners to switch. He's charming, petty, and a surprisingly good singer.
characters.signature_look: White man in his 40s, slicked-back black hair, thin pencil mustache, smug charming smile; shiny grey sharkskin suit, black skinny tie, red pocket square

characters.name: Lydia Vex
characters.hook: The only engineer in the South Bay who's as good as Rusty, and she knows it.
characters.bio: Lydia built Static's transmitter from salvage and spite. She and Rusty went to the same trade school and haven't spoken since a science-fair dispute. She jams signals for Sterling, but she hates doing sloppy work.
characters.signature_look: Chinese-American woman in her 30s, sharp black bob, cat-eye glasses with red lenses, arched eyebrows, cool smirk; black jumpsuit with red piping, soldering iron in hand
characters.catchphrase: Rusty Vance builds it. I improve it.

characters.name: Morty Spangle
characters.hook: He's written every catchy ad you can't get out of your head.
characters.bio: Morty writes Channel Static's jingles on a toy piano and sells them to anyone who'll pay. He's easily bribed with sandwiches. He secretly loves the morning edition.
characters.signature_look: White man in his 50s, round face, thinning hair combed over, big grin, rosy nose; loud orange-and-black checked jacket, straw boater hat

characters.name: Count Kilocycle
characters.hook: A masked late-night DJ who hijacks frequencies for the fun of it.
characters.bio: Nobody knows who the Count really is, only that he plays the best records at 2 A.M. on any frequency he wants. He's a prankster, not a crook. Ziggy is his biggest fan.
characters.signature_look: Mysterious man of uncertain age, brown skin, wearing a black domino eye mask, thin smile, slick black hair; high-collared black cape lined with red, vintage headphones

characters.name: Mack Brody
characters.hook: He sells scrap from fallen satellites, and he'd love a piece of the Lantern.
characters.bio: Mack dives the Redondo submarine canyon for anything that falls from the sky and sells it to Static. He's gruff and a little crooked, but he once pulled Kip out of a rip. He doesn't talk about that.
characters.signature_look: White man in his 40s, ruddy sunburned face, red beard, broken nose, squint; black wetsuit top, old brass diving helmet held under arm

characters.name: Static
characters.hook: A robot with a TV screen for a face that can drown out any signal.
characters.bio: Static was built by Lydia to jam the Lantern's broadcast, but it gets distracted by any good song. Its face shows snow when it's thinking and test patterns when it's happy. It's starting to like the morning edition.
characters.signature_look: Boxy retro robot with an old television screen for a face showing black-and-white static snow, two rabbit-ear antennas, black and red enamel body, menacing but goofy

characters.name: Dr. Cornelius Hollow
characters.hook: He wants to catch the next meteor shower and sell it by the pound.
characters.bio: Cornelius was asked to leave Skywatch after an incident with a giant magnet. He now plans to capture meteors in orbit and sell them as souvenirs. His plans are clever, his execution is not.
characters.signature_look: Gaunt white man in his 60s, pale skin, sunken cheeks, slicked-back grey hair, thin goatee, sly smile; black lab coat, monocle

characters.name: Barnaby Fitch
characters.hook: He wants to paint advertisements across the sky, right next to the Lantern.
characters.bio: Barnaby sells real estate, used cars and dreams, and lately he's selling billboard space in orbit. He talks fast and signs everything in triplicate. Mayor Dot keeps a file on him.
characters.signature_look: Portly white man in his 50s, red cheeks, slicked hair, toothy salesman grin; loud teal plaid suit, orange bow tie, holding a rolled blueprint
characters.catchphrase: Have I got a deal for you.

characters.name: Nix Dubois
characters.hook: A sixteen-year-old who hijacks the pier's loudspeakers and may switch sides any day now.
characters.bio: Nix is a radio whiz who takes jobs from Sterling just to prove they can. They've hijacked the pier PA twice and the high school bell once. Rusty thinks they could be the best engineer in town someday.
characters.signature_look: Black teenager age 16, androgynous, brown skin, short twists, mischievous grin; oversized black leather jacket with red patches, homemade radio antenna on headband

characters.name: Agnes Thrash
characters.hook: Owner of the afternoon paper, who would very much like the morning edition to be late.
characters.bio: Agnes publishes the Evening Clarion and has been trying to scoop the morning edition for thirty years. She's sharp, ruthless, and has never been late with a paper herself. She and Gussie play bridge on Thursdays.
characters.signature_look: White woman in her 60s, severe grey updo, sharp features, thin red lips, calculating smile; black dress with high collar, pearl necklace, fountain pen

characters.name: Ambassador Quoril
characters.hook: A three-eyed diplomat who heard the morning edition four light-years out and came to subscribe.
characters.bio: Quoril arrived in a teardrop ship just past the Lantern's orbit and asked politely for a copy of the paper. It speaks in a gentle chime and collects weather reports. It is very concerned about the swell.
characters.signature_look: Tall graceful alien with smooth teal skin, three large golden eyes, elongated head with a crest of soft fins, serene expression; cream high-collared robe with orange geometric trim
characters.catchphrase: Greetings. Is the paper on time?

characters.name: Zibbo
characters.hook: A tiny orange alien who hitched a ride home on the Gull's tail fin.
characters.bio: Zibbo latched onto the Gull during the spacewalk and rode it all the way to El Segundo. It speaks only in beeps and loves the diner's pancakes. Benny is teaching it to throw papers.
characters.signature_look: Small cute round orange alien with one big eye, two wiggly antennae, tiny arms, a big happy smile, soft rubbery look

characters.name: The Choir
characters.hook: A crystalline being in high orbit that sings in radio frequencies.
characters.bio: The Choir floats past the Lantern every few months and hums in harmony with its carrier signal. Yuki recorded its songs, and they sound like the morning edition played backward. It means no harm; it just loves music.
characters.signature_look: Glowing crystalline alien being made of faceted teal and cream crystals forming an abstract face with glowing orange eyes, radiating soft light rings

characters.name: Captain Ostra Vey
characters.hook: A gruff space-trucker who hauls ice comets past the Lantern every Tuesday.
characters.bio: Ostra Vey has driven the comet route for three hundred years and stops at the Lantern for Penny's pie. She has four arms, a long beard of tentacles, and a laugh like thunder. She once towed the Gull out of a meteor stream.
characters.signature_look: Burly alien woman with orange skin, four arms, a beard of short tentacles, small sharp kind eyes; battered teal space-trucker jacket with patches, cap

characters.name: Lumen
characters.hook: A glowing jellyfish creature who drifts near the Lantern's beacon like a moth near a porch light.
characters.bio: Lumen floats on the solar wind and glows brighter when the beacon is lit. When the Lantern went dark, it dimmed too. It can't speak, but it can make the whole sky shimmer.
characters.signature_look: Translucent glowing alien jellyfish with soft teal and orange bioluminescent bell and trailing tendrils, gentle face-like pattern with two glowing eyes

characters.name: MOTH-1
characters.hook: A forgotten old satellite that woke up, grew curious, and drifted home.
characters.bio: MOTH-1 was launched in 1949 and lost track of. Somewhere along the way it started thinking. It now drifts near the Lantern, listening to the morning edition and trying to remember who built it.
characters.signature_look: Old battered round retro satellite robot with solar panel wings like moth wings, two round glowing lamp eyes, long whip antennas, cream and teal panels with rust spots

characters.name: Professor Glorm
characters.hook: A tentacled scholar from the Ophir Belt studying the South Bay's paddle league.
characters.bio: Glorm came to Earth to study human culture and became fascinated by pickleball. He takes notes on every match with five pencils at once. He has very strong opinions about the kitchen line.
characters.signature_look: Plump friendly alien with lavender-grey skin, several short tentacles, large round glasses on two big eyes, bushy brows; cream tweed jacket with elbow patches, bow tie

characters.name: Cmdr. Asha Rangan
characters.hook: When the Lantern's dish was knocked loose, it was beaming the morning edition straight at her.
characters.bio: Asha runs the Moon's tiny relay base and was startled to receive the South Bay's weather at 4:30 A.M. She radioed the Aero Works to say the dish was pointed at her. She's been a devoted listener ever since.
characters.signature_look: Indian-American woman in her 40s, brown skin, short black hair with grey streaks, calm commanding smile; white spacesuit with orange shoulder patches, fishbowl helmet held under arm

characters.name: Ember
characters.hook: A little glowing stone from the meteor shower who feels terrible about the dish.
characters.bio: Ember was part of the shower that knocked the Lantern off its mark. It apologized in a flash of light and has stayed to help ever since. It now warns Anand whenever its cousins are coming.
characters.signature_look: Small glowing rock creature, cracked charcoal stone with an orange molten glow inside, two big sorry eyes, tiny smile, sparks around it

characters.name: Vrill the Collector
characters.hook: A smooth-talking trader who'd like the Lantern's beacon for his collection.
characters.bio: Vrill collects shiny things from across the galaxy and has his eye on the orange beacon. He offers fair trades and then unfair ones. Odessa has told him no forty-three times.
characters.signature_look: Slender alien with pale red skin, long narrow face, big gleaming black eyes, sly grin, golden earrings; dark navy robes covered in jeweled trinkets
